title: kbext.py verify calls each extender a group configured with its point's sample inputs and checks the answer's shape, so a group's CI catches a break at pull time
goal: each point of kbext.SURFACE carries sample inputs and a shape check of its answer; kbext.py verify --root WS loads every extender the settings layers name and calls it with its point's samples in a child process with a timeout; it prints one line per extender, ok or what failed with the point, the module and the layer; a load failure or a KBEXT_REQUIRES mismatch counts as a failure; verify exits 0 when all pass or none is configured, 1 on a failure, 2 on bad arguments; extending.md gives the command a group's CI runs after each upstream pull
